name: CREATE_NFT_COLLECTION
description: Create a new NFT collection (NonFungibleUnique token) on the Hedera Token Service. The operator key is used as admin and supply key by default. Max supply can optionally be capped.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Operator key is set as both admin and supply key by default
implicitBehaviors.details: Uses agent.privateKey.publicKey for setAdminKey() and setSupplyKey(). Custom keys can be provided via adminPrivateKey and supplyPrivateKey inputs.
Uses agent.accountId for setTreasuryAccountId(). NFTs are minted to the operator's account.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Decimals and initial supply are always 0 for NFTs
implicitBehaviors.details: NonFungibleUnique tokens must have decimals=0 and initialSupply=0. These are hardcoded.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Supply type defaults to Infinite when maxSupply is omitted
implicitBehaviors.details: If maxSupply is not provided, TokenSupplyType.Infinite is used. If maxSupply is provided, TokenSupplyType.Finite is set along with setMaxSupply().

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Custom admin/supply keys require additional signing
implicitBehaviors.details: When adminPrivateKey or supplyPrivateKey is provided, the public key is extracted for the transaction and the private key is used for signing after freezeWith().

inputs.name: name
inputs.describe: The human-readable name of the NFT collection

inputs.name: symbol
inputs.describe: The ticker symbol for the collection (e.g. 'DGEN')

inputs.name: maxSupply
inputs.describe: Optional max supply cap. Omit for unlimited.

inputs.name: memo
inputs.describe: Optional memo attached to the collection

inputs.name: adminPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Admin key (only if different from operator key)

inputs.name: supplyPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Supply key (only if different from operator key)

successData.name: tokenId
successData.describe: The newly created NFT collection token ID

successData.name: hasAdminKey
successData.describe: Always true — an admin key is always set

successData.name: hasSupplyKey
successData.describe: Always true — a supply key is always set

errorMap.details: Not enough HBAR to cover the NFT collection creation fee (~1 HBAR).
Transaction signature is invalid. Check your keys.
The account ID does not exist on this network.
